title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) C: Lens modelling pipeline overview
comment: 29 pages, 16 figures. Submitted to A&A. Catalogue: https://euclid-eclipse-lenses.org ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19654904
summary: Galaxy-scale strong lenses provide precise measurements of galaxy mass distributions, magnified views of distant galaxies, and a competitive cosmological probe. Historically, such studies have been limited to hundreds of lenses, with automated modelling methods proving difficult to scale. We present automated lens modelling of 15 072 strong-lens candidates from Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1), over an order of magnitude larger than any previously modelled sample. Using PyAutoLens-JAX, we perform three fits with multi-Gaussian expansion (MGE), pixelised, and Sérsic representations of the source, adopting an isothermal ellipsoid mass model with external shear. These fits provide foreground lens-light subtraction, adaptive Delaunay source reconstructions, and deblended photometry. More than 20 expert inspectors visually assess the resulting models, and each model is assigned the classification on which at least 75% of its inspectors agree. Of the 6073 grade A (secure) lens candidates, inspectors classify 4098 (67.5%) as successfully modelled, 580 (9.6%) as failures, 317 (5.2%) as multi-galaxy lenses, 15 (0.2%) as double-source-plane lenses, and 7 (0.1%) as unsure if lens, while 1032 (17.0%) reach no consensus and 24 (0.4%) have incomplete models. For the 8999 grade B (probable) candidates, the modelling success rate falls to 43.1%, primarily reflecting an increase in cases without consensus (37.6%), rather than a comparable increase in agreed failures (12.9%). Successfully modelled grade A and B systems have a median effective Einstein radius of 0.85 arcsec and a median total $I_E$-band source magnification of 8.1. We publicly release the successful lens models, their inferred properties, and magnified-source reconstructions through the ECLIPSE catalogue, demonstrating automated modelling at Euclid sample sizes and enabling population-level strong-lensing science.

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Example results of automated preprocessing for the lens Euclid-DR1 J030313.592 \(-\) 580619.97. North is up and east is to the left, as in all images in this paper. Left : An RGB image using one colour scaling that contrasts the lens and source light with that of a nearby galaxy to the north-east. Right : An RGB image with different colour scaling that shows the fitting mask, candidate conjugate points, and contaminating-galaxy contour used in lens modelling. The white dashed circle shows the fitting mask, whose radius is computed from the furthest pixel in the segmented source emission, plus an additional buffer. White crosses with black outlines mark the automatically identified candidate conjugate points. The magenta contour marks a nearby contaminating galaxy whose light overlaps the fitting region and is therefore effectively excluded from the likelihood by zeroing its data values and inflating its RMS values.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：透镜Euclid-DR1 J030313.592 \(-\) 580619.97的自动化预处理示例结果。北向上，东向左，如本文所有图像所示。左：使用一种颜色缩放的RGB图像，将透镜和源的光与东北方向附近星系的光形成对比。右：使用不同颜色缩放的RGB图像，显示了透镜建模中使用的拟合掩膜、候选共轭点和污染星系轮廓。白色虚线圆显示拟合掩膜，其半径由分割源发射中最远像素计算得出，并加上额外缓冲。带有黑色轮廓的白色十字标记自动识别的候选共轭点。品红色轮廓标记附近的一个污染星系，其光与拟合区域重叠，因此通过将其数据值置零并增大其RMS值，有效地将其从似然中排除。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Example VIS PyAutoLens lens-model summary for the lens candidate J030313.592 \(-\) 580619.97, the same system shown in Fig. 1 . The top row shows, from left to right, the VIS data, the full model image, the signal-to-noise ratio map, and a maximally zoomed view of the reconstructed source plane. The middle row shows the foreground lens-light model, the lens-subtracted image, the lensed source model image, and a mid-zoom source-plane reconstruction. The bottom row shows the normalised residual map, the same residual map plotted in the range from \(-1\sigma\) to \(+1\sigma\) , the \(\chi^{2}\) map, and the full source-plane reconstruction. figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Two outcomes of the Double Source Plane Lens (DSPL) classification. Panels follow the same layout as Fig. 3 . The top row shows a genuine DSPL that inspectors correctly identified. Whilst the RGB image already provides strong visual evidence for multiple lensed sources, the poor lens-model fit resulting from the violation of the single-source-plane assumption provides an additional diagnostic that the system is a DSPL. The bottom row shows a grade A candidate receiving \(4/5\) ( \(80\%\) ) DSPL votes. The additional blue feature south of (below) the lens may have motivated the DSPL classification, but its nature is uncertain: it could be associated with the main lensed source, a second lensed source, or an unrelated line-of-sight object. Visual agreement alone therefore does not establish the presence of two lensed sources at distinct redshifts.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：双源平面透镜（DSPL）分类的两种结果。面板布局与图3相同。顶行显示检查员正确识别的真实DSPL。虽然RGB图像已经为多个透镜化源提供了强烈的视觉证据，但违反单源平面假设导致的透镜模型拟合不佳提供了额外的诊断，表明该系统是DSPL。底行显示一个A级候选体，获得\(4/5\)（\(80\%\)）的DSPL投票。透镜以南（下方）的额外蓝色特征可能促使了DSPL分类，但其性质不确定：它可能与主透镜化源、第二个透镜化源或无关的视线物体有关。因此，仅凭视觉一致性不能确定存在两个不同红移的透镜化源。

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) B: Discovery pipeline overview
comment: 23 pages, 13 figures, submitted to A&A. Paper intended for the A&A Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
summary: We present the method used to identify the $15\,000$ high-grade galaxy-galaxy strong lens candidates in Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Given that lenses are intrinsically rare systems and the DR1 data set is vast, this lens search was conducted in a number of stages: a catalogue-level cut; a machine-learning and ensemble search; a two-stage citizen-science search, and finally grading of lens candidates by strong lens researchers. In this paper, we describe each search stage and their respective results. This search was enabled by the automated classification of over 68 million objects by neural networks, more than 4.5 million classifications of $300\,000$ objects by citizen-scientist volunteers, and the inspection of over $30\,000$ objects by strong lens researchers. We find this multi-stage approach helps maximise the number of lenses identified, while minimising inspection requirements of both citizen scientists and strong lens researchers. We measure a completeness in our comprehensive search of $0.73_{-0.15}^{+0.08}$ to grade A ('definite') systems and $0.34_{-0.06}^{+0.05}$ to grade A+B ('definite' + 'probable') systems. Our search therefore identifies the majority of the definitive strong lens systems in the DR1 area with the remainder likely to be fainter or more ambiguous cases. We find that researcher grading remains subjective; in this work we implement calibration to account for biases of individual inspectors and highlight the benefit of lens modelling (ECLIPSE-C) in determining the nature of a lens candidate. This paper forms part of the ECLIPSE series, here focussing on the discovery pipeline used to identify lens candidates in Euclid DR1; an overview of the lenses discovered is presented in ECLIPSE-A.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了在Euclid数据发布1（DR1）中识别$15\,000$个高质量星系-星系强透镜候选体所采用的方法。鉴于透镜本质上是稀有系统，而DR1数据集规模庞大，本次透镜搜索分多个阶段进行：目录级筛选；机器学习和集成搜索；两阶段公民科学搜索；最后由强透镜研究人员对透镜候选体进行分级。在本文中，我们描述了每个搜索阶段及其各自的结果。本次搜索得益于神经网络对超过6800万个天体的自动分类、公民科学家志愿者对$300\,000$个天体的超过450万次分类，以及强透镜研究人员对超过$30\,000$个天体的检查。我们发现这种多阶段方法有助于最大化识别出的透镜数量，同时最小化公民科学家和强透镜研究人员的检查需求。我们在全面搜索中测得对A级（‘确定’）系统的完备度为$0.73_{-0.15}^{+0.08}$，对A+B级（‘确定’+‘可能’）系统的完备度为$0.34_{-0.06}^{+0.05}$。因此，我们的搜索识别了DR1区域内大多数确定的强透镜系统，其余可能是更暗或更模糊的情况。我们发现研究者分级仍然主观；在这项工作中，我们实施了校准以考虑个体检查者的偏差，并强调了透镜建模（ECLIPSE-C）在确定透镜候选体性质方面的益处。本文是ECLIPSE系列的一部分，这里聚焦于用于识别Euclid DR1中透镜候选体的发现流程；所发现透镜的概述见ECLIPSE-A。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该多阶段策略在最大化识别透镜数量的同时，降低了公民科学家与研究者的检查负担；搜索能识别DR1区域内多数确定的强透镜系统，其余可能为更暗或更模糊的情形。研究者分级仍具主观性，需校准偏差，透镜建模有助于判定候选体性质。本文属于ECLIPSE系列，聚焦DR1发现流程，透镜总览见ECLIPSE-A。（基于可用摘要）

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) A: Strong lens catalogue overview
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to A&A as part of the Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release"
summary: We present 15 072 high-confidence strong lens candidates in Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1), spanning 2000 deg$^2$. These comprise 6073 grade A ('sure lens') and 8999 grade B ('probable lens') systems, which we publish alongside a further 9010 grade C ('possible lens') candidates. With more high-confidence candidates than all previous catalogues combined, this sample establishes a large, homogeneous data set of galaxy-scale strong lenses with high-resolution imaging, transforming strong lensing from a field of rare discoveries to a robust statistical tool for astrophysics and cosmology. Of the roughly 900 million sources in DR1, we searched the 68 million passing our catalogue selection using a bespoke discovery pipeline that synthesises scores from five machine-learning models with visual classifications from around 7000 citizen scientists and 67 strong lensing experts. Beyond classical Einstein rings, our catalogue includes 84 candidate double-source-plane lenses and over 1000 candidate disc lenses, two exotic classes with few previously known examples, as well as several hundred candidate lensed AGN and quasars. We deliver automated lens models for the combined grade A+B systems, and photometric redshifts and stellar population properties for the deflector galaxies, providing immediate science-ready data products. We find that the majority of the deflector galaxies are massive and quiescent, with stellar masses of $\log_{10}(M_\ast /M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$ (Salpeter initial mass function; 16th-84th percentile range). The deflector galaxies span a range of photometric redshifts ($z=0.68 ^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$), extending to higher redshifts than previous ground-based lens samples, and the lenses have a typical Einstein radius of $0.85 ^{+0.44}_{-0.24}$ arcsec. Extrapolating by area, we expect over 100 000 high-confidence strong lens candidates in the Euclid Wide Survey.

AI.tldr: Euclid DR1 中发布 15072 个高置信度强引力透镜候选体（6073 个 A 级、8999 个 B 级），另加 9010 个 C 级候选，并给出自动透镜模型、测光红移与恒星族参数。
AI.motivation: 强引力透镜此前多为零星发现，样本小、非同质且多为地面低分辨率成像，难以作为统计工具使用；Euclid 高分辨率宽视场成像有望把该领域转变为可靠的统计与宇宙学探针。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们在Euclid数据发布1（DR1）中呈现了15072个高置信度强透镜候选体，覆盖2000 deg$^2$。其中包括6073个A级（“确定透镜”）和8999个B级（“可能透镜”）系统，并与另外9010个C级（“潜在透镜”）候选体一同发布。该样本的高置信度候选体数量超过以往所有星表的总和，建立了一个大规模、同质的星系尺度强透镜数据集，并具有高分辨率成像，将强透镜从罕见发现领域转变为天体物理和宇宙学的稳健统计工具。在DR1中约9亿个源中，我们使用定制的发现流程搜索了通过星表选择的6800万个源，该流程综合了五个机器学习模型的评分以及约7000名公民科学家和67名强透镜专家的视觉分类。除经典爱因斯坦环外，我们的星表还包括84个候选双源面透镜和超过1000个候选盘状透镜，这两类奇异类别此前已知例子很少，以及数百个候选透镜化AGN和类星体。我们为合并的A+B级系统提供自动透镜模型，并为偏转体星系提供测光红移和恒星族性质，提供可直接用于科学的数据产品。我们发现大多数偏转体星系是大质量且宁静的，恒星质量为$\log_{10}(M_\ast /M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$（Salpeter初始质量函数；第16-84百分位范围）。偏转体星系覆盖一定范围的测光红移（$z=0.68 ^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$），延伸至比以往地面透镜样本更高的红移，透镜的典型爱因斯坦半径为$0.85 ^{+0.44}_{-0.24}$ arcsec。按面积外推，我们预期在Euclid宽巡天中拥有超过100000个高置信度强透镜候选体。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该工作建立了大样本、同质、高分辨率且可直接用于科学分析的星系级强透镜数据集，偏转体红移分布较以往地面样本更高；按面积外推，Euclid 宽巡天预期可获逾 10 万个高置信度强透镜候选。

title: The Carousel Lens III: Joint lens convergence and source kinematic modeling
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables, submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics
summary: We introduce a new, independent modeling component to the Carousel Lens series by exploiting the spatially-resolved kinematics contained within the lensed arcs, which so far has remained rather underexplored in strong-lensing analyses. We present an end-to-end forward-modeling framework that reconstructs an integral-field spectroscopic datacube from a parameterization of the lens convergence profile together with the line-of-sight velocity, velocity dispersion, and surface brightness profiles of the unlensed source. The kinematic structure of the source acts as an additional set of ray-traceable markers distributed across every lensed image, inaccessible from imaging data alone. Furthermore, by generating an [OII] emission-line datacube, we isolate a single source redshift and remove lens and line-of-sight light contamination. We apply this framework to deep VLT/MUSE observations of the Carousel Lens, modeling the [OII] emission of the quadruply-imaged star-forming galaxy at $z_{\rm s} = 1.432$ that anchors the system's cosmography constraints. We measure an Einstein radius $θ_{\rm E} = 12.816''^{+0.005}_{-0.007}$ and a logarithmic slope $γ= 1.412^{+0.002}_{-0.002}$, tightening the statistical uncertainties on both by roughly a factor of $2-2.5$ relative to the corresponding flat emission-line map model. We find that the source galaxy exhibits a strong rotation, lies confidently along the star-forming main sequence, and has an inferred central black hole mass of $\log M_{\rm BH}/M_{\odot} = 7.89 \pm 0.51$. These results establish datacube-level forward modeling as a practical and independent route to traditional image-based lens models in the current systematics-limited regime, and one that extends naturally to this system's other lensed sources and to other lens systems.

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Euclid Lens Identification Pipeline and Scientific Exploration (ECLIPSE) D: Photometric redshifts and the first census of strong lenses in the galaxy evolution framework
comment: Paper intended for the A&A Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release''
summary: The Euclid mission is revolutionising the study of strong gravitational lenses by providing high-resolution imaging over an unprecedented survey area, increasing the number of known lenses by two orders of magnitude compared to previous surveys. Characterising this sample of lens-galaxies requires accurate measurements of their physical properties. However, standard catalogue photometry often blends the light from the foreground lens and the lensed background source, limiting the reliability of derived galaxy parameters. We present a homogeneous catalogue of photometric redshifts and physical properties for 9538 galaxy-scale strong lenses identified in Euclid's DR1 strong-lens sample. We use deblended multiwavelength photometry obtained from the lens modelling of Euclid and ground-based images with PyAutoLens. The photometric redshifts of the lens galaxies are estimated using the template-fitting code Phosphoros. The stellar masses, SFRs, stellar ages, and metallicities are inferred through SED fitting with Prospector, adopting a flexible non-parametric SFH and a Salpeter IMF. The robustness of the inferred parameters is assessed through comparisons with spectroscopic redshifts and external galaxy surveys. The sample of lenses spans a broad redshift range of $0.13\lesssim z_{\rm phot} \lesssim 1.98$, with a median $z_{\rm phot} = 0.68^{+0.33}_{-0.29}$. The sample is dominated by massive quiescent galaxies with a $M_\ast$ range $[10^{10},\,10^{12.1}]\,M_\odot$ and a median $\log_{10}(M_\ast/M_\odot) = 11.39^{+0.29}_{-0.33}$. This catalogue represents one of the first large-scale characterisations of strong-lens galaxies in the Euclid era. By combining deblended photometry with homogeneous photometric redshift and SED-fitting analyses, it provides a foundation for studies of galaxy evolution, lens-galaxy scaling relations, and the connection between stellar and total mass in strong lenses.

title: Confirming HSC strong lens candidates with DESI Spectroscopy. II. Analysis of 80 galaxy-scale systems with lens redshifts above 0.8
summary: The total mass distribution of galaxies provides a sensitive probe of the fundamental physical processes governing galaxy evolution, including gas inflow/star formation, AGN/SN feedback, galaxy merging, and the nature of dark matter. State-of-the-art cosmological simulations have therefore made extensive predictions for the evolution of the total-mass density slope. Interestingly, their predictions diverge significantly at high redshift, primarily due to differences in how these key physical mechanisms are implemented. However, measurements of the total-mass structure evolution have been largely confined to low and intermediate redshifts, leaving the regime where model predictions differ most significantly (z>0.8) largely unexplored. In the first paper of this series, we reported the discovery of 84 candidate strong-lens systems with lens redshifts above 0.8. In this work, we perform lens modeling of the 80 galaxy-scale systems to assess their lensing nature. Of these, 71 systems (approximately 90%) exhibit clear lensing features that are well reproduced by our lens models and are therefore classified as secure strong lenses. Another eight systems are classified as probable (5) or possible (3) strong lenses, based on the prominence of their lensing features and the quality of the lens modeling. One system lacking reliable lensing features in current imaging data is classified as a non-lens. Our analysis nearly triples the number of known galaxy-scale strong lenses at z_lens > 0.8, making statistical studies of the total mass structure of high-redshift galaxies possible for the first time. This expanded sample provides an unprecedented opportunity to test the predictions of cosmological simulations and discriminate between competing physical prescriptions.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 星系的总质量分布为探测主导星系演化的基本物理过程提供了灵敏的探针，这些过程包括气体流入/恒星形成、AGN/SN反馈、星系并合以及暗物质的性质。因此，最先进的宇宙学模拟对总质量密度斜率的演化做出了大量预测。有趣的是，这些预测在高红移处显著分歧，主要源于这些关键物理机制实现方式的差异。然而，对总质量结构演化的测量大多局限于低红移和中等红移，使得模型预测差异最显著的区间（z>0.8）在很大程度上未被探索。在本系列的第一篇论文中，我们报告了84个透镜红移高于0.8的候选强透镜系统。在这项工作中，我们对其中80个星系尺度系统进行透镜建模，以评估其透镜性质。其中，71个系统（约90%）展现出清晰的透镜特征，且与我们的透镜模型吻合良好，因此被归类为确凿的强透镜。另外八个系统根据其透镜特征的显著性和透镜建模的质量被归类为可能的（5个）或潜在的（3个）强透镜。一个在当前成像数据中缺乏可靠透镜特征的系统被归类为非透镜。我们的分析使已知的z_lens > 0.8星系尺度强透镜数量几乎增加了两倍，首次使得对高红移星系总质量结构的统计研究成为可能。这一扩展样本为检验宇宙学模拟的预测并区分竞争性物理方案提供了前所未有的机会。

title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). NISP spectroscopy of gravitational arcs and multiple images
comment: Paper intended for the A&A Special Issue "Euclid First Data Release". 15 pages, 5 figures
summary: Applications of strong gravitational lensing in astrophysics and cosmology critically depend on building reliable strong lensing models, which require accurate measurements of on-sky positions of multiple images and of the redshifts of the background sources from which they originate. In this context, Euclid is a unique facility, as it simultaneously provides high-resolution multi-band photometric imaging and slitless spectroscopy for an unprecedentedly large sample of gravitational lenses, most of which are newly discovered. In this work, we exploit Euclid slitless spectroscopic data to determine the redshifts of four spatially extended lensed sources, and to reconstruct emission-line images. Specifically, two of the target sources are lensed into giant arcs by the massive galaxy clusters SPT-CLJ0411$-$4819 ($z_\mathrm{d}=0.424$, where "d" denotes the lensing deflector) and Abell 2280 ($z_\mathrm{d}=0.326$). The third system is a quadruply imaged active galactic nucleus (AGN) candidate strongly lensed by a massive galaxy at $z_\mathrm{d}=0.68$, while the fourth is a galaxy-scale Einstein ring produced by a lens galaxy at $z_\mathrm{d}=0.235$. This work represents a proof of concept for the exploitation of Euclid slitless spectroscopic data in the study of strong gravitational lensing, providing one of the first determinations of spectroscopic redshifts for strongly lensed features from NISP spectra. These results demonstrate the feasibility of applying the same methodology to the very large sample of gravitational lenses that Euclid has started to discover and is expected to identify over the course of the mission.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Euclid无缝光谱数据测量四个强引力透镜源的光谱红移并重建发射线图像，验证了该方法在大样本透镜研究中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的强引力透镜模型依赖于多重像在天球上的精确位置以及背景源红移的准确测量。Euclid同时提供高分辨率多波段成像和无缝光谱，覆盖前所未有的大样本（多为新发现）引力透镜，是开展此类测量的独特平台。
AI.method: 利用Euclid无缝光谱（NISP）数据，对四个空间延展的透镜源测定红移，并重建其发射线图像。目标包括：被大质量星系团SPT-CLJ0411-4819（z_d=0.424）和Abell 2280（z_d=0.326）透镜成巨弧的两个源；一个被z_d=0.68大质量星系强透镜的四重像AGN候选体；以及一个由z_d=0.235透镜星系产生的星系尺度爱因斯坦环。
AI.result: 成功获得四个延展透镜源的光谱红移，并重建了发射线图像，其中包含首批基于NISP光谱对强透镜特征给出的光谱红移测定之一，属概念验证性质。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 强引力透镜在天体物理学和宇宙学中的应用，关键取决于能否建立可靠的强透镜模型，而这需要精确测量多重像的在天空位置以及产生这些像的背景源的红移。在这一背景下，Euclid 是一个独特的设施，因为它同时为前所未有的庞大引力透镜样本（其中大多数是新发现的）提供高分辨率多波段测光成像和无缝光谱。在本工作中，我们利用 Euclid 无缝光谱数据来确定四个空间延展的透镜源的红移，并重建发射线图像。具体而言，其中两个目标源被大质量星系团 SPT-CLJ0411$-$4819（$z_\mathrm{d}=0.424$，其中“d”表示透镜偏转体）和 Abell 2280（$z_\mathrm{d}=0.326$）透镜成巨弧。第三个系统是一个四重成像的活动星系核（AGN）候选体，被一个位于 $z_\mathrm{d}=0.68$ 的大质量星系强透镜；第四个是由位于 $z_\mathrm{d}=0.235$ 的透镜星系产生的星系尺度爱因斯坦环。本工作是利用 Euclid 无缝光谱数据研究强引力透镜的概念验证，提供了首批基于 NISP 光谱对强透镜特征的光谱红移测定之一。这些结果证明了将相同方法应用于 Euclid 已开始发现并预计在任务期间识别的大量引力透镜样本的可行性。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 该工作证明可将此方法推广应用于Euclid已开始发现并将在任务期间持续识别的大量引力透镜样本，为强透镜建模和天体物理、宇宙学应用奠定基础。（基于可用摘要）

title: Prospects for probing supermassive binary black holes in strongly lensed active galactic nuclei via microlensing effects
summary: Gravitational microlensing in strongly lensed active galactic nuclei (AGNs) provides a powerful probe of accretion-disk structure and may offer a unique opportunity to identify sub-parsec supermassive binary black holes (SMBBHs) through distinctive signatures. Upcoming wide-field surveys are expected to discover a large sample of strongly lensed AGNs, a fraction of which may host SMBBHs detectable via microlensing. In this paper, we employ semi-analytic models to assess the detection prospects of sub-parsec SMBBHs in lensed AGNs, focusing on systems with resolvable multiple images suitable for microlensing analysis. Accounting for galaxy-scale strong-lensing statistics, and including the cluster-lensing contribution as an optimistic statistical extension, we estimate that up to approximately 87 such systems could be spatially resolved by individual upcoming surveys, including the Vera C. Rubin Observatory (Rubin), Euclid, China's Space Survey Telescope (CSST), and the Roman. For the Rubin WFD survey, we estimate that periodic oscillations in microlensing light curves could identify $\sim0.12-0.68$ short-period ($<5$\,yr) binaries, whereas diagnostics based on the reconstructed size-wavelength relation apply to a broader population, potentially identifying $\sim0.4-5.3$ systems, depending on the model assumptions. CSST, Euclid, and Roman may also reveal up to $10.6$, $8.9$, and $1.2$ systems exhibiting size-wavelength features, and $2.3$, $1.9$, $0.3$ systems showing periodic oscillations, which should be regarded as imaging-selected candidates whose microlensing-based identification requires adequate time-domain follow-up, including cadence, monitoring baseline, photometric precision, and reliable time-delay measurements. Our results show that strongly lensed AGNs provide a promising, though observationally demanding, pathway for finding candidate SMBBHs via microlensing.

AI.tldr: 本文用半解析模型评估了在强透镜AGN中通过微引力透镜探测亚秒差距超大质量双黑洞的可行性，并给出各巡天项目的预期探测数目。
AI.motivation: 微引力透镜可探测活动星系核吸积盘结构，并有望通过特征信号识别亚秒差距超大质量双黑洞；未来宽场巡天预期发现大量强透镜AGN，其中一部分可能含有可用微引力透镜探测的双黑洞，但探测前景尚缺乏定量评估。
AI.method: 采用半解析模型，考虑星系尺度强透镜统计，并将星系团透镜作为乐观的统计扩展；聚焦可分辨多重像、适合微引力透镜分析的系统，估计Rubin、Euclid、CSST与Roman等巡天的探测数目，并考察微引力透镜光变曲线中的周期性振荡与重建的尺寸—波长关系两类诊断。

AI.conclusion: 强透镜AGN为通过微引力透镜寻找候选超大质量双黑洞提供了有前景但观测要求苛刻的途径；这些系统应视为成像筛选的候选体，其微引力透镜识别需要充分的时域后续观测，包括采样频率、监测基线、测光精度与可靠的时间延迟测量。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 强透镜活动星系核（AGN）中的引力微引力透镜为探测吸积盘结构提供了强有力的手段，并可能通过独特的信号为识别亚秒差距超大质量双黑洞（SMBBH）提供独特机会。即将开展的宽视场巡天预计将发现大量强透镜AGN，其中一部分可能宿主可通过微引力透镜探测的SMBBH。本文采用半解析模型评估透镜化AGN中亚秒差距SMBBH的探测前景，重点关注具有可分辨多重像、适合微引力透镜分析的系统。考虑星系尺度强透镜统计，并将星系团透镜贡献作为乐观的统计扩展纳入，我们估计即将开展的单个巡天（包括Vera C. Rubin天文台（Rubin）、Euclid、中国空间巡天望远镜（CSST）和Roman）最多可在空间上分辨约87个此类系统。对于Rubin WFD巡天，我们估计微引力透镜光变曲线中的周期性振荡可识别约$\sim0.12-0.68$个短周期（$<5$\,yr）双星，而基于重建的尺寸-波长关系的诊断适用于更广泛的群体，可能识别约$\sim0.4-5.3$个系统，具体取决于模型假设。CSST、Euclid和Roman也可能分别揭示多达$10.6$、$8.9$和$1.2$个表现出尺寸-波长特征的系统，以及$2.3$、$1.9$、$0.3$个表现出周期性振荡的系统，这些应被视为成像筛选的候选体，其基于微引力透镜的识别需要充分的时域后续观测，包括采样频率、监测基线、测光精度和可靠的时间延迟测量。我们的结果表明，强透镜AGN为通过微引力透镜寻找候选SMBBH提供了有前景但观测要求苛刻的途径。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 强透镜AGN为通过微引力透镜寻找候选超大质量双黑洞提供了有前景但观测要求苛刻的途径；这些系统应视为成像筛选的候选体，其微引力透镜识别需要充分的时域后续观测，包括采样频率、监测基线、测光精度与可靠的时间延迟测量。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Optical depth \(\tau\) and the number distribution of close SMBBHs against redshift. The blue solid curve shows the optical depth for galaxy-galaxy strong lensing modeled with SIE [ 15 ] . The orange dashed curve represents the optical depth after including the cluster lensing contribution estimated with a halo-mass-function-based spherical NFW+SIS proxy following Ref. [ 17 ] . The black dotted curves illustrate the number distributions of close SMBBHs (with \(r\) -band magnitude \(<25\) ) against redshift resulting from the BBH-nonevol and BBH-zevol models, respectively.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：光学深度\(\tau\)与近距SMBBH数量随红移的分布。蓝色实线表示用SIE建模的星系-星系强透镜光学深度[15]。橙色虚线表示在纳入星系团透镜贡献后的光学深度，该贡献采用基于晕质量函数的球对称NFW+SIS代理按参考文献[17]估计。黑色点线分别展示BBH-nonevol和BBH-zevol模型产生的近距SMBBH（\(r\)波段星等\(<25\)）数量随红移的分布。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Cumulative number distribution of close SMBBHs expected to undergo strong lensing based on the lensing optical depth (across all sky) after 1000 Monte Carlo realizations, shown as a function of the original-source \(r\) -band magnitude before lensing realizations. The black solid curve denotes the cumulative counts under the BBH-nonevol model, while the blue dashed curve shows the corresponding results when cluster lenses are included. The orange solid and yellow dashed curves indicate the predictions of the BBH-zevol model considering galaxy lensing only and galaxy+cluster lensing, respectively. title: The PAU Survey: Dissecting strong-lensing systems with narrow-band photometric redshifts
summary: Wide-field imaging surveys such as Euclid will identify large samples of strong-lens candidates, whose scientific use requires redshifts for both deflectors and lensed sources. Source redshifts are challenging because faint arcs are blended with foreground light. We test lens-model-informed photometry on eight known strong lenses, using broad-band models to define component regions, point-reflection subtraction to reduce contamination, and PAU Survey narrow bands combined with five HSC or CFHT broad bands. BCNz estimates separate lens and source redshift distributions without imposing their expected ordering. All eight lens redshift peaks agree with spectroscopy within $|δ_z|\leq0.014$, where $δ_z=(z_b-z_{\rm spec})/(1+z_{\rm spec})$. Four source peaks, all at $z_{\rm s}^{\rm spec}\leq1.23$, agree within $|δ_z|\leq0.025$. Symmetric subtraction reduces the median source $|δ_z|$ from 0.336 to 0.071. At $|δ_z|<0.05$, narrow- plus broad-band photometry yields eight lens and four source matches, versus three and two using EAZY with broad bands alone. These results demonstrate component redshift recovery in blended systems and support redshift-based lens-candidate assessment alongside morphology and colour. Larger narrow-band surveys, including J-PAS, could extend this approach, pending uncertainty calibration and blind candidate tests.

title: VENUS: Strong Lens Mass Models and Einstein Radii of 60 Galaxy Clusters
summary: We present the strong lens mass modeling result of 60 galaxy clusters targeted by Vast Exploration for Nascent, Unexplored Sources (VENUS), the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) multi-epoch Treasury program. We obtain refined mass models for the 60 clusters with the glafic software by fitting positions of $\sim 4500$ multiple images, $\sim 1150$ of which are newly identified multiple images with help of multi-band JWST images. Each cluster contains typically $\sim 50$ multiple images, thanks to the selection of target clusters based on their high lensing strengths. We validate our models with the Jackknife method. The median Einstein radius is $\sim 30''$ and the distribution of the Einstein radii extends out to $\sim 60''$ for the source redshift of 9, which confirms that their lensing strengths are indeed among the highest known to date. For the source redshift of 9, we identify MACS J0717.5+3745, MACS J0600.1$-$2008, and PLCK G287.0+32.9 as clusters with the largest Einstein radii as well as the largest areas of the high-magnification ($|μ|>10$) regions. We find that the observed Einstein radii of VENUS clusters are fully compatible with the standard cold dark matter model.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们展示了由詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）多历元财政部项目“新生未探索源大规模探索”（VENUS）所观测的60个星系团的强透镜质量建模结果。我们利用glafic软件，通过拟合约4500个多重像的位置，获得了这60个星系团的精细质量模型，其中约1150个多重像是借助JWST多波段图像新识别出的。由于目标星系团是基于其高透镜强度筛选的，每个星系团通常包含约50个多重像。我们采用Jackknife方法验证了模型。对于源红移为9的情况，爱因斯坦半径的中位数约为30角秒，且爱因斯坦半径分布延伸至约60角秒，这证实了它们的透镜强度确实属于迄今已知的最高之列。对于源红移为9，我们确定MACS J0717.5+3745、MACS J0600.1$-$2008和PLCK G287.0+32.9为具有最大爱因斯坦半径以及最大高放大率（$|\mu|>10$）区域面积的星系团。我们发现VENUS星系团观测到的爱因斯坦半径与标准冷暗物质模型完全一致。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: VENUS 60个星系团的强透镜质量建模给出了迄今透镜强度最高的一批星系团模型，可作为JWST高红移源研究的透镜参考；其爱因斯坦半径统计与标准冷暗物质宇宙学预言一致，未发现需要偏离该模型的证据。（基于可用摘要）

title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). Refining the strong lens sample with Space Warps crowd-sourced science
summary: We demonstrate the efficacy of crowd-sourced refinement of strong gravitational lens candidate samples by citizen scientists. Binary (lens/non-lens) classification by citizen scientists has been conducted previously, and here we extend such categorisation into `definite', `probable', `possible', and `non-lenses'. This grading is a required stage ahead of any strong lens sample publication and is usually carried out by (small) teams of researchers. We compare the responses of the volunteers to those of strong lens researchers and discuss the optimal strategy for lens classification and grading in future strong lens searches. Volunteers are found to be able to correctly identify systems of each grade, and their responses can be calibrated to be comparable to those of researchers. Grade posteriors, defined as the probability that a strong lens system classified by the volunteers is a certain grade, converge most rapidly for non-lens systems. We find that one researcher classification is equivalent to only 1.9 volunteer classifications when grading such systems. There is significant disagreement in the grading of intermediate-grade lens candidates amongst both volunteers and researchers. Moving towards calibrated lens probabilities for future lens searches would help to account for such subjectivity. If the Q1 lens search was rerun with volunteers performing lens grading (and corresponding calibration), a completeness of 79% for Grades A+B (corresponding to definite + probable lenses respectively) could be achieved with 41% purity prior to researcher inspection - this would correspond to an expected 12500 true lenses (i.e. excluding contaminants) in Euclid DR1.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们展示了公民科学家对强引力透镜候选样本进行众包精炼的有效性。此前已开展过公民科学家的二元（透镜/非透镜）分类，在此我们将这种分类扩展为“确定”、“可能”、“疑似”和“非透镜”。这种分级是任何强透镜样本发布之前必需的阶段，通常由（小规模）研究团队完成。我们比较了志愿者与强透镜研究人员的响应，并讨论了未来强透镜搜寻中透镜分类和分级的最优策略。研究发现，志愿者能够正确识别各个等级的系統，并且他们的响应可以被校准到与研究人员相当的水平。等级后验概率，定义为志愿者分类的强透镜系统属于某一等级的概率，对于非透镜系统收敛最快。我们发现，在对这类系统进行分级时，一位研究人员的分类仅相当于1.9次志愿者分类。在中间等级透镜候选体的分级上，志愿者和研究人员之间都存在显著分歧。在未来透镜搜寻中转向校准后的透镜概率将有助于解释这种主观性。如果Q1透镜搜寻重新运行，由志愿者进行透镜分级（并进行相应校准），那么在研究人员检查之前，A+B级（分别对应确定+可能透镜）的完整度可达到79%，纯度为41%——这相当于在Euclid DR1中预期有12500个真实透镜（即排除污染体）。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要的结论：众包多级分级可有效替代或补充小型研究者团队的初筛工作，但中间等级存在主观性，未来透镜搜寻应转向校准后的透镜概率以吸收此类主观差异。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4 : Top: Distribution of the grades assigned by the SW-Refine volunteers to each system. Each stacked bar represents a single system, and the bars have been normalised to have a height of 1. The systems are shown in decreasing order of their GJ score ranking. The horizontal bars indicate the GJ grade boundaries, {A: green, B: orange, C: red, X: black}, while the solid lines show running averages. There is broad correlation between the SW-Refine score and GJ ranking, although the volunteers are less likely to assign a Grade A than the researchers. Bottom: As above, but where the length of each of the stacked bars represents the grade posterior \(p(G_{i}|\{C_{j}\})\) rather than the raw proportion of grades assigned for each system. The grade posteriors for a given system sum up to unity; hence, when stacked, the bars reach \(y=1\) . This Bayesian calibration makes the grading more confident – the highest ranked Grade A systems are upweighted relative to the raw grade proportions, while the low ranking Grade X systems receive \(p(G_{i}=X|\{C_{j}\})\approx 0\) even if they received a few Grade C classifications.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：上：SW-Refine志愿者为每个系统分配的等级分布。每个堆叠条代表单个系统，条被归一化为高度1。系统按其GJ分数排名降序显示。水平条表示GJ等级边界，{A：绿色，B：橙色，C：红色，X：黑色}，而实线显示滑动平均值。SW-Refine分数与GJ排名之间存在广泛相关性，尽管志愿者比研究人员更不可能分配A级。下：同上，但每个堆叠条的长度代表等级后验概率\(p(G_{i}|\{C_{j}\})\)，而不是为每个系统分配的等级的原始比例。给定系统的等级后验概率之和为1；因此，当堆叠时，条达到\(y=1\)。这种贝叶斯校准使分级更加自信——排名最高的A级系统相对于原始等级比例被上调权重，而排名低的X级系统即使收到一些C级分类，也获得\(p(G_{i}=X|\{C_{j}\})\approx 0\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5 : Evolution of the grade posteriors across all available test systems as they receive an increasing number of classifications from SW-Refine, SW-Classify, and GJ members. The panels show the posteriors for systems that received researcher Grades A–X (left to right). The GJ posteriors converge the fastest, as expected since the GJ consensus grade is defined as the ground truth. SW-Refine posteriors converge faster than those of SW-Classify, and the fastest for Grade A and Grade X systems. The error bars include \(68\%\) of the grade posteriors; their size is indicative of the subjective nature of grading. The green curves show the grade posteriors using SW-Refine classifications, having calibrated the volunteer responses using each individual user’s skill, whereas the purple curves treat the volunteer crowd as a single super-user with a single skill matrix. title: What can strong lensing recover in edge-on disc galaxies? A mock study based on TNG50 simulations
summary: Strong gravitational lensing tightly constrains the projected mass within the Einstein aperture, but what else imaging alone can recover for edge-on disc lenses remains untested against known truth. We construct HST/ACS-like mock observations of 35 edge-on TNG50 disc galaxies selected to resemble lenses from the Sloan WFC Edge-on Late-type Lens Survey (SWELLS), and fit them with a five-stage Source-Light-and-Mass workflow in PyAutoLens; the final model represents the lens mass distribution by scaling the Multi-Gaussian Expansion (MGE) foreground-light template with a global mass-to-light ratio and adding a spherical NFW halo. Decomposed fits succeed for 21 of the 35 systems; in the other 14, coherent MGE lens-light residuals prevent reliable modelling. For the successful subset, the Einstein radius and the total aperture mass are recovered with normalised median absolute deviation (NMAD) scatters of 0.3% and 0.7%. The global projected mass-weighted slope has an NMAD scatter of 10.3%, smaller than that of the mass-sheet-invariant reduced deflection curvature $ξ$ (11.4%) and well below that of the local slope (40.7%), while the stellar and dark-matter aperture masses scatter by 15.1% and 108.8%. A 35-system true-light diagnostic using the exact input light gives component-mass scatters of 0.8% and 6.3%. Under these controlled assumptions, imaging constrains Einstein-scale total mass and global radial structure more reliably than local radial structure or the stellar-dark-matter decomposition.

title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1). Mass-to-light ratio of elliptical galaxies: constraints from strong lensing
summary: Mass is among the most fundamental properties describing a galaxy. The relation between the luminosity and the total mass of a galaxy contains information on the efficiency of the star formation process and on the distribution of dark matter. We used strong gravitational lensing data from the Euclid Quick Data Release 1 (Q1) to constrain the total mass enclosed within an aperture of $5\,h^{-1}$kpc, $M_5$, of elliptical galaxies. Our analysis is based on a sample of 95 lenses, which we built by ensuring that their selection function is reproducible. This enabled us to correct our inference for selection effects. The average $\log_{10}{(M_5\,h\,M_\odot^{-1})}$ for a galaxy with an $r$-band luminosity of $10^{10.7}L_{\odot}\,h^{-2}$ at $z=0.5$ is $11.30\pm0.02$. The mass $M_5$ scales with luminosity to the power $β_\mathrm{L}=0.71\pm0.07$, and decreases with increasing redshift at fixed luminosity. Assuming a scenario in which galaxies grow by mergers and stellar populations evolve passively, these correlations imply that $M_5$ increases with time for individual galaxies. These measurements provide a useful benchmark for testing models of galaxy structure and evolution that make predictions on the distribution of total mass on the scales of $5\,h^{-1}$kpc.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 质量是描述星系最基本属性之一。星系的光度与总质量之间的关系包含了关于恒星形成过程效率以及暗物质分布的信息。我们利用欧几里得快速数据发布1（Q1）的强引力透镜数据，来约束椭圆星系在 $5\,h^{-1}$kpc 孔径内包含的总质量 $M_5$。我们的分析基于一个包含95个透镜的样本，该样本的构建确保了其选择函数是可重复的。这使我们能够校正推断中的选择效应。对于红移 $z=0.5$、$r$ 波段光度为 $10^{10.7}L_{\odot}\,h^{-2}$ 的星系，其平均 $\log_{10}{(M_5\,h\,M_\odot^{-1})}$ 为 $11.30\pm0.02$。质量 $M_5$ 随光度按幂律 $\beta_\mathrm{L}=0.71\pm0.07$ 缩放，并在固定光度下随红移增加而减小。假设星系通过并合增长且星族被动演化，这些相关性意味着对于单个星系，$M_5$ 随时间增加。这些测量为检验在 $5\,h^{-1}$kpc 尺度上预测总质量分布的星系结构和演化模型提供了有用的基准。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：若星系通过并合增长且星族被动演化，上述相关性意味着单个星系的 $M_5$ 随时间增加；该测量可作为检验 $5\,h^{-1}$kpc 尺度总质量分布模型的基准。

title: Two-dimensional galaxy cluster shapes using lensing data: a simulated analysis
comment: submitted to A&A, 16 pages, 9 figures; comments are welcome
summary: Context. Cluster morphology reflects assembly history and dynamical state. High-resolution weak lensing can reveal departures from spherical symmetry, but its ability to recover two-dimensional shapes remains less explored. Aims. We assess how reliably weak lensing recovers projected cluster morphology and its dependence on orientation and dynamical state. We also compare large-scale weak-lensing morphology with that traced by strong lensing near the cluster centre. Methods. We study three clusters at $z=0.22$ from The Three Hundred Project, representing relaxed, mildly disturbed and unrelaxed systems. For each, we consider three random projections and three along the principal axes of the mass tensor. For each projection, we generate 128 weak-lensing catalogues with a source density of 30 arcmin$^{-2}$ and intrinsic ellipticity dispersion $σ_ε=0.3$. We constrain mass and concentration from one-dimensional NFW and BMO fits, then recover ellipticity, position angle and centre using a two-dimensional elliptical NFW model. We also measure morphology from true convergence maps, Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions and strong-lensing tangential critical lines. Results. Recovered parameters depend on orientation and dynamical state. The relaxed cluster has similar inner and large-scale shapes, whereas disturbed systems appear more elliptical centrally. Two-dimensional weak-lensing modelling recovers the projected mass orientation despite source sampling and shape noise. Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions recover the position angle well but favour rounder mass distributions. Centroid offsets are larger in unrelaxed systems. Conclusions. Combining weak- and strong-lensing morphology probes cluster structure across physical scales and offers a promising way to investigate morphology and dynamical state.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 背景。星系团形态反映了其组装历史和动力学状态。高分辨率弱引力透镜可以揭示偏离球对称的结构，但其恢复二维形状的能力仍较少被探索。目标。我们评估弱引力透镜恢复投影星系团形态的可靠性及其对取向和动力学状态的依赖。我们还比较了大尺度弱引力透镜形态与星系团中心附近强引力透镜所描绘的形态。方法。我们研究来自The Three Hundred Project的$z=0.22$处的三个星系团，分别代表弛豫、轻度扰动和未弛豫系统。对于每个星系团，我们考虑三个随机投影和沿质量张量主轴的三个投影。对于每个投影，我们生成128个弱引力透镜星表，源密度为30 arcmin$^{-2}$，内禀椭率弥散$σ_ε=0.3$。我们通过一维NFW和BMO拟合约束质量和浓度，然后使用二维椭圆NFW模型恢复椭率、位置角和中心。我们还从真实收敛图、Kaiser \& Squires重建和强引力透镜切向临界线测量形态。结果。恢复的参数取决于取向和动力学状态。弛豫星系团的内侧和大尺度形状相似，而扰动系统在中心显得更椭圆。尽管存在源采样和形状噪声，二维弱引力透镜建模仍能恢复投影质量取向。Kaiser \& Squires重建能很好地恢复位置角，但倾向于更圆的质量分布。未弛豫系统中的质心偏移更大。结论。结合弱引力透镜和强引力透镜形态可在不同物理尺度上探测星系团结构，为研究形态和动力学状态提供了一种有前景的方法。

title: Constraining the Inner Dark Matter Profiles of Strong-Lensing Galaxy Clusters
summary: We present mass modeling of three strong lensing galaxy clusters found in the Dark Energy Survey utilizing Hubble Space Telescope imaging for lens modeling, and complementary constraints from Chandra X-ray observations. All three clusters are relaxed and have giant arc or ring lens structures ideal for constraints on the dark matter distribution. The strong lens modeling and X-ray temperatures yield consistent total cluster mass estimates. We find these clusters have best-fit X-ray temperatures of $2.7 - 6.2$ keV and total masses of M$_{200} = (1-6) \times 10^{14} M_{\odot}$. Our lens models parameterize dark matter distribution with a generalized Navarro-Frenk-White (GNFW) density profile. While the GNFW profile allows the inner dark matter slope to vary, we find in all cases that the inner slopes are consistent with the standard NFW density profile $γ^{DM} = 1$. The X-ray surface brightness distributions for all three clusters are generally symmetric with no significant substructure, supporting the conclusion that these are relaxed clusters. In addition, we find generally low values of the external shear magnitude with median values ranging $|γ^{ext}| = 0.04-0.09$ and consistent with zero for two of the clusters.

title: SN Ares: A Strongly Lensed Type IIb Supernova at $\mathbf{z=1.276}$ with a Predicted 70-Year Time Delay
comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables, submitted to ApJ
summary: We present the discovery of supernova (SN) Ares, a strongly lensed supernova at $z_{\rm spec}=1.276\pm0.002$ in a massive, triply imaged host galaxy behind the MACS J0308.9+2645 galaxy cluster. JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy spanning the rest-frame optical to NIR of Ares reveals helium features at $5876\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, $7065\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, and $10830\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, as well as H$α$ and Pa$β$. A comparison to local core-collapse SN spectra and light curves leads to a classification of SN Ares as a Type IIb supernova, the highest-redshift member of its class spectroscopically identified. A comparison to local SN IIb light curves provides a phase estimate for the spectrum of $34_{-9}^{+10}$ rest-frame days post-radioactive peak, providing a unique view into a high-redshift stripped-envelope supernova in its late-photospheric evolution. A lens model of the cluster constructed using recent JWST data indicates that SN Ares is the first image to arrive and will reappear in two future images near the center of the cluster plane in $\gtrsim 70$ years, with predicted magnifications of $\sim5\times$ and $\sim1.5\times$. Planned JWST/NIRSpec Multi-Object Spectroscopy of the cluster will allow for more detailed modeling of the lensed system for tighter constraints on the time delay and magnifications, as well as a template spectrum at the location of SN Ares.

title: Semi-Analytic Predictions for Strong-Lensing Perturbers in Cold and Self-Interacting Dark Matter
summary: Strong gravitational lensing is sensitive to the abundance and internal structure of dark matter halos, providing a probe of gravothermal evolution in self-interacting dark matter (SIDM). We combine semi-analytic cold dark matter (CDM) subhalo histories with a model for gravothermal evolution in SIDM to generate CDM and SIDM subhalo populations across SIDM parameter space. We predict their projected enclosed masses and deflection-based projected density slopes and compare them with three perturbers inferred through gravitational imaging in PJ011646, SDSS J0946+1006, and JVAS B1938+666. For SIDM model parameters $σ_0/m_χ=147.1$ cm$^2$/g and $w=120$ km/s, SIDM subhalos reproduce all three perturbers more often than CDM subhalos. For PJ011646, we find ~0.6 cored SIDM subhalos per host matching the perturber, compared with ~0.002 in CDM, while core-collapsed subhalos are too steep. For SDSS J0946+1006, we find ~3 core-collapsed and ~0.004 cored SIDM subhalos per host, compared with none in 900 CDM realizations, although baryons, neglected here, may matter for such massive subhalos. For "detection V" in JVAS B1938+666, we find ~220 core-collapsed and ~20 cored SIDM subhalos per host within the $2σ$ posterior region, compared with ~0.2 in CDM; the CDM candidates require exceptionally early accretion, at median redshift $z\sim13$. Simultaneously reproducing all three perturbers requires $w\gtrsim10^2$ km/s, so that the massive (~$5.6\times10^{10}M_\odot$) progenitors of SDSS J0946+1006 candidates can collapse, and is achieved for $σ_0/m_χ\gtrsim10^2$ cm$^2$/g in the parameter sets studied. Our results show how semi-analytic models can quantify how often subhalos reproduce individual perturbers in different dark matter models, and our modular framework can be readily updated as models of tidal stripping and late-stage gravothermal evolution in SIDM improve. (abridged)

title: Gamma-ray Bursts as Cosmological Probes Calibrated with Strongly Lensed Quasars and Neural Networks
summary: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) extend distance measurements to redshifts beyond those routinely probed by Type Ia supernovae, but their use in cosmology is limited by calibration circularity and possible redshift-dependent effects. We investigate strongly lensed quasars as external calibrators of the Amati and Combo GRB relations. We reconstruct the luminosity-distance relation using an artificial neural network trained on TDCOSMO strong-lensing distances, with the absolute scale inherited from the lensing-only calibration. To avoid extrapolation, only GRBs within the lens-supported redshift interval are used for calibration. We then infer cosmological parameters through a hierarchical Bayesian analysis of flat $Λ$CDM, with $w_0w_a$CDM examined as a consistency test. For flat $Λ$CDM, Amati yields $H_0=78.26^{+17.87}_{-16.30}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.670^{+0.223}_{-0.276}$, while Combo yields $H_0=78.71^{+13.83}_{-11.29}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.635^{+0.235}_{-0.242}$. Amati is relatively insensitive to the phenomenological redshift term, whereas Combo shows a stronger dependence. Injection--recovery tests indicate that an unmodelled positive Combo trend can bias $H_0$ and $Ω_m$ upward. Strong-lens calibration therefore offers a route to extending the GRB Hubble diagram, but the inferred $H_0$ is not an independent GRB measurement: it retains the TDCOSMO distance scale. The precision is limited by GRB scatter, redshift-dependent systematics, and lens-modelling uncertainties.

title: Late-time distance consistency and model-independent curvature inference with strong lensing, quasars, and galaxy clusters
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics (RAA)
summary: We revisit a late-time, model-independent distance-consistency framework that combines strong gravitational lensing systems (SGLS), ultraviolet/X-ray quasars (QSOs), and 38 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich/X-ray galaxy-cluster angular-diameter distances. The analysis focuses on systematics rather than on presenting a competitive curvature measurement. Starting from the 158-system SGLS catalog, we exclude 30 systems that violate the lensing-geometric requirement $D_{A,ls}/D_{A,s}<1$ in the isothermal reference case $γ_{\rm lens}=2$, leaving a fixed 128-system SGLS parent sample for cross-matching with 1598 QSOs. A deterministic maximum-cardinality, minimum-mismatch one-to-one assignment yields 100 SGLS--QSO pairs at the nominal $Δd/d=5\%$ threshold. We propagate the measured X-ray flux uncertainties and the intrinsic QSO scatter, and, crucially, we include the full $38\times38$ covariance induced by using the same QSO distances in the kernel-smoothed cluster predictions. With $Ω_K\sim\mathcal{U}[-10,10]$, the joint posterior is $Ω_K=2.085^{+1.634}_{-1.103}$ (68\%; central 95\% interval $[0.269,6.028]$). We do not interpret the positive shift as evidence for an open Universe. \added{This positive posterior offset is driven by cross-probe calibration tensions, sample-assignment effects, and the cluster anchor; it cannot be attributed to the intrinsic spatial geometry of the Universe.} The SGLS+QSO data alone leave curvature essentially prior dominated, $Ω_K=0.70^{+6.33}_{-7.12}$, whereas removing only the off-diagonal cluster covariance moves the posterior to $Ω_K=5.21^{+2.46}_{-2.07}$. Thus the cluster anchor supplies most of the curvature constraining power and its covariance materially changes the posterior location.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了一个晚期、模型无关的距离一致性框架，该框架结合了强引力透镜系统（SGLS）、紫外/X射线类星体（QSOs）以及38个Sunyaev--Zel'dovich/X射线星系团角直径距离。分析侧重于系统误差，而非呈现一个具有竞争力的曲率测量。从158个系统的SGLS目录出发，我们排除了30个在等温参考情况 $γ_{\rm lens}=2$ 下违反透镜几何要求 $D_{A,ls}/D_{A,s}<1$ 的系统，留下一个固定的128个系统的SGLS母样本，用于与1598个QSOs交叉匹配。确定性的最大基数、最小失配一对一分配在名义 $Δd/d=5\%$ 阈值下产生100个SGLS--QSO对。我们传播了测量的X射线通量不确定度和QSO内禀散射，并且关键地，我们包括了在核平滑星系团预测中使用相同QSO距离所引起的完整 $38\times38$ 协方差。取 $Ω_K\sim\mathcal{U}[-10,10]$，联合后验为 $Ω_K=2.085^{+1.634}_{-1.103}$（68\%；中心95\%区间 $[0.269,6.028]$）。我们不将正向偏移解释为开放宇宙的证据。\added{这一正向后验偏移由跨探针校准张力、样本分配效应和星系团锚点驱动；它不能归因于宇宙的内禀空间几何。} 仅SGLS+QSO数据使曲率基本上由先验主导，$Ω_K=0.70^{+6.33}_{-7.12}$，而仅移除非对角星系团协方差将后验移至 $Ω_K=5.21^{+2.46}_{-2.07}$。因此，星系团锚点提供了大部分曲率约束能力，其协方差实质性地改变了后验位置。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：星系团锚点提供了大部分曲率约束能力，其协方差显著改变后验位置；因此该联合框架当前只能作为系统性诊断工具，联合后验的正向偏移不应被解释为开放宇宙的证据，曲率测量的稳健性高度依赖锚点与跨探针一致性处理。

title: Statistical Strong Lensing V. Inference with Microlensed Quasars
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics
summary: Microlensing of strongly lensed quasars provides direct information on the stellar component of lens galaxies, and can help break the degeneracy between the stellar initial mass function (IMF) and the dark matter. However, a statistical framework to forward model microlensing data while accounting for strong lensing selection effects is still missing. We incorporated microlensing effects into the hierarchical model of Paper III, and investigated to what extent flux measurements of strongly lensed quasars can break the degeneracy between the stellar IMF and the dark matter distribution. We tested the method on a mock sample of 219 doubly imaged quasars, lensed by circularly symmetric lenses. When microlensing effects are modelled, the inference using image fluxes recovers the input foreground population parameters and provides tighter constraints than the inference without flux constraints. The improvement is clearest in the $μ_α-μ_5$ plane, where $μ_α$ describes the mean stellar population synthesis mismatch parameter $\logα_{\rm SPS}$ and $μ_5$ describes the mean projected dark matter mass within $5\,{\rm kpc}$. The 68% credible interval on $μ_α$ shrinks from 0.16 dex to 0.09 dex, with the degeneracy between $μ_α$ and $μ_5$ significantly reduced. By contrast, fitting the image fluxes without accounting for microlensing leads to large biases on the inferred parameters. This work is a first step towards an accurate modelling of microlensing data. Application to real lens samples will require dropping the circular symmetry assumption and adopting more realistic models for the microlensing magnification.
